paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Paper's own deposit is GSE273041 (DA.p1). Exercise effects are defined as change from BL within each diet at H0 and H2 (S2.3.p1, S2.3.p6, S5.6.p3) with FDR<0.05 and |log2FC|>1. Per-contrast DEG totals are only partly unambiguous in text (S2.3.p2-p6).

checks.data_processing: FASTQs from different flow cells were combined for a given sample using NGmerge,alignment via TopHat,Assembly: ensembl Hg19,Supplementary files format and content: processed data are RPKM normalized read counts

ownership.reasoning: Metadata series_id GSE273041 = paper's DA accession; 60 samples = 20 athletes x 3 biopsies; 30 HiCarb / 30 LowCarb; 20 Base/IP/IP120 each; TopHat + Hg19 + RPKM matches S5.6.p2. The only supplementary matrix is GSE273041_raw_counts.txt.gz.

alignment.reasoning: All 60 matrix columns match the GEO 'description' field exactly (e.g. CC39020001_1_Base). Matrix column CC39020003_1_IP20 carries a typo ('IP20') but maps exactly via description to GSM8417462, whose timepoint field is IP120 (participant id '1_IP20' carries the same typo); subject and time come from the participant-id and timepoint fields, and the participant-id suffix agrees with timepoint for every sample.

matrix.reasoning: Integer fraction 0, min 0.052, max 70,799, median 1.98: linear normalized. GEO data_processing says 'processed data are RPKM normalized read counts' and S5.6.p2 describes easyRNASeq RPKM with low values replaced by the 10-read RPKM equivalent (per-gene floor ~0.109 visible). The file name 'raw_counts' is misleading; no integer counts were deposited, so count methods are excluded. 25,262 genes vs 25,282 reported in S2.1.p1 (20-gene difference).

final.parameterization: tgrp = BL for every baseline sample, otherwise <diet>_<time>; with subject fixed effects (which absorb diet) this equals ~ subject + diet:time with diet-specific time effects; each coefficient is a within-diet change from BL
final.estimand_type: within-subject exercise effect, per diet group

design.reasoning: 20 athletes each biopsied at BL/H0/H2 (complete, unique); diet is between-subject. Exercise estimand per paper = change from BL within each diet at H0 and H2 (4 planned contrasts).

Fixed subject effects replace the paper's random subject intercept; for within-subject contrasts in a complete balanced design these give the same point estimates.

final.method: limma (lmFit + contrasts.fit + eBayes, inmoose) via run_multigroup_analysis

paper_route.method: mixed-effect ANOVA (car, subject random effect) + Tukey post-hoc on RPKM, BH FDR
paper_route.reason: no executor for car Type-I mixed ANOVA + Tukey post-hoc; R car route not available in repository tools

method.reasoning: Deposited data are RPKM (linear), so count methods are invalid; limma on log2(RPKM+1) with a subject block and planned contrasts is the validated route for repeated-measures linear-normalized data. This is a declared deviation from the paper's mixed ANOVA/Tukey route.

final.deviation_note: Paper FDR came from BH on mixed-model/Tukey p-values; here BH is applied within each limma moderated-t contrast. log2FC is the limma coefficient on log2(RPKM+1), which is compressed toward 0 for low-expressed genes relative to a log2 ratio of mean RPKM.

threshold.reasoning: Paper: FDR < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1 (S5.6.p3), applied unchanged on the deviation route.

final.deviation: limma on log2(RPKM+1) with fixed subject block instead of mixed ANOVA + Tukey
